title: ASCII creature collection RPG
author: One_Low8664
selftext:
About 28k lines of TypeScript on three.js r128 with a custom GPU renderer. Every character is a GPU instance, the 49 creatures are generated from a seeded code DSL, the ground is a shader-driven glyph field over A\* pathfinding, all sound is synthesized in the browser, and four player co op merges shared state across clients over a real-time room.

Not happy about the trailer. Loving the style and the fantasy, and would love some feedback on gameplay, which in my opinion is not there yet. 

[https://bug.games/games/kernova](https://bug.games/games/kernova)
